### God Can Turn Your Mistake into a Miracle!
Author: Bayless Conley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/god-can-turn-your-mistake-into-a-miracle-11555627.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 23:5
Points:
- Hopeless or unchangeable circumstances can be completely transformed when handed over to God.
- Just as God altered Moses' rod, He has the power to change the fundamental nature of our problems.
- Deuteronomy 23:5 reveals God's ability to turn an intended curse directly into a blessing.
- God's primary motivation for turning mistakes into miracles is His steadfast love for His people.
- Believers are encouraged to release their burdens and trust God to bring about positive change.
